ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; visible ventral surface consists of approximately 45 percent low-intensity dark pixels concentrated centrally and 55 percent high-intensity white pixels distributed across lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark contiguous geometric region; lateral lobes are predominantly high-intensity white with high-frequency dark mottling and feathering patterns at the transition boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing boundary; multiple jagged peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitude variations visible against the background water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the outer edges of the fluke lobes sweeping from the distal tips to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) on distal tips and leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity white pigmentation regions on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive trailing edge serration and physical trauma; prominent barnacle colonization on distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique isolated dark pixel focal spots within the white high-intensity region of the lower-right lobe.
